from pathlib import Path
pdir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689854/attempts/71aa0823e1d7415ab0ea5a5c0e56a9c6/system/state/workspace/programs')
pdir.mkdir(exist_ok=True,parents=True)
pf=pdir/'task-6567adcf.py'
source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    """Map each separator-bounded panel to 1 iff it contains >=2 marks."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_seps = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    col_seps = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    row_cuts = [-1] + row_seps + [h]
    col_cuts = [-1] + col_seps + [w]
    # Exclude separator lines when finding the panel background color.
    sep_rows, sep_cols = set(row_seps), set(col_seps)
    counts = Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
                     if r not in sep_rows and c not in sep_cols)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = []
    for r0, r1 in zip(row_cuts, row_cuts[1:]):
        if r1 == r0 + 1:
            continue
        out_row = []
        for c0, c1 in zip(col_cuts, col_cuts[1:]):
            if c1 == c0 + 1:
                continue
            marks = sum(grid[r][c] != background
                        for r in range(r0 + 1, r1)
                        for c in range(c0 + 1, c1))
            out_row.append(1 if marks >= 2 else background)
        out.append(out_row)
    return out
'''
pf.write_text(source)
